notes.title: Peachleaf Pirates is OUT NOW! Here's what island life has in store for you
notes.notes:
It's launch day – Peachleaf Pirates is OUT NOW! Before you head off to enjoy the tropical blue skies and sunshine, we thought it would be useful to give a rough overview of what you can expect from island life. 

[b]Price: $6.99
Launch discount: 10% off for the first week[/b]

[h3][b]LAUNCH TRAILER[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=onWUXz52F9c;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]GETTING STARTED[/b][/h3]
Your adventure begins with you - Joe - washed ashore on Peachleaf Island, a tropical paradise and pirate haven. And, wouldn't you know it, you have no idea how you got there. Complete amnesia. What are the chances!? After being made an official citizen of Peachleaf, you're given your own wooden cabin, a plot of land, some basic tools and a pack of mango seeds. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38929209/45f7bec6b13b5937827e0daaf1e61ae9ca7486ab.png[/img]

You'll be greeted at your plot by Rupert, a local goblin with plenty of wisdom to impart via a tutorial, which we recommend all first-time players go through. Don't worry, it's not [i]too[/i] painful and gives you all the basics you need to get started.

After the tutorial it's up to you what to do next – Peachleaf can be played at your own pace, and you can focus on whatever aspect appeals to you the most, whether it's completing quests, spending time farming, or developing your combat skills.  

[h3][b]QUESTING[/b][/h3]
The main story pits you against the no-good, all-around bad egg, Lord Rathmore. He wants to corrupt the ancient and mysterious Peachleaf Tree, which – legend says – sustains the precarious balance between the forces of good and evil voodoo on the island. Save the tree to save the day! 

In addition to rescuing the fabled flora, there are several side-quests to keep you busy. You'll 
come across these by talking with Peachleaf residents, and exploring the island. Tasks include fun activities such as foraging for a carrot, locating a misplaced parrot, and investigating a cult. Island life is never dull.

[h3][b]FARMING[/b][/h3]
There are over 30 different types of crop to grow and harvest during the island's four different seasons (warm, wet, dry, and hurricane). These include such exotic wonders as firemelons, glow peppers, stonedrops, and pinkberries. Harvesting crops gives you XP and, once harvested, they can be sold, used in recipes, or eaten raw for some HP and energy. Growing crops isn't a total breeze, however. They can be prone to disease, and pesky, light-fingered goblins. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38929209/d37c9f26e23bb0d6cdbe64e9acd7905dcf75889d.gif[/img]

As you progress through the game, you'll be able to introduce six different species of animal to your farm: chickens, tortlings, bees, kualakus, brachi, and dinoflies. These all have their uses. For example, dinoflies can eventually be put to work harvesting crops, which is one less job for you to worry about.

[h3][b]COMBAT ADVENTURING[/b][/h3]
The jungle can be a dangerous place and there are plenty of beasties to battle, which is why you eventually arm yourself with a sword and gun for melee and ranged combat respectively. Defeating enemies earns XP that can be used to level-up your combat skills and unlock a range of increasingly powerful attacks. You can also unlock the mysterious, magical powers of voodoo, which allows you to use earth, wind, and fire elemental spell-casting. These can also be upgraded with XP. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38929209/2744c970c48acb3e52ee6cf06e796d9ed432de55.gif[/img]

While you will encounter the odd wandering fiend among the island foliage, if you really want to rack up combat XP, and also bag some riches and resources while you're at it, there's a jungle temple you can visit which is crawling with creatures just waiting to be vanquished. 

[h3][b]CRAFTING[/b][/h3]
You know the drill by now – gather resources to make stuff. When you first get started, there are only eight items available to craft, but as you progress, level-up, and research, you'll eventually have over 120 craftable items to choose from. These range from a bog-standard wooden fence, all the way up to a flashy water fountain. 

[h3][b]LEVELING-UP AND RESEARCHING[/b][/h3]
Self-improvement is a key factor of island life, and there are seven unique skill trees to level up, with over 95 different skills. 

As previously mentioned, participating in combat and voodoo earns XP, which can be used to level-up combat and voodoo skills. In addition, working on the farm harvesting crops, chopping down trees, smashing rocks etc., gives XP that can be used to improve homesteading skills. Upgrading these results in better crops, better animal products, better fishing, and a variety of other benefits. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38929209/360c3c293ba7a548738c6eb9e4dc090de1695b3d.gif[/img]

Also, whenever homesteading is leveled-up, it awards you with a research point. These can be spent to unlock new items, upgrades, and objects, such as water features, potion table, jam cooker, fermentation barrel, dinofly nest, and plenty more cool stuff besides.

Aaaaand, whenever any XP is earned, some of it always goes towards general XP, which can be used to level-up – you guessed it – a general skill. These include increased energy and HP, increased evasion, increased attack damage, increased benefits from potions and fruit etc., etc.  

[h3][b]YOU'RE READY FOR PEACHLEAF PIRATES[/b][/h3]
So that's a condensed overview of what to expect from Peachleaf Pirates. There is much more to learn and discover, but most of the fun comes from learning and discovering it all for yourself, so dive in and get started! Although, if you would like a little extra friendly guidance, you can [b][url=https://peachopedia.com/index.php?title=Main_Page]use the Peachopedia[/url][/b]!

If you encounter any issues or bugs while playing, please report them here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1156510/discussions/0/2959418287753995118/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1156510/discussions/0/2959418287753995118/[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38929209/f2749278e87be942efb69bf324134b34936c9c04.gif[/img]

A huge thanks to everyone who has supported Peachleaf so far, whether by giving it a wishlist, downloading a demo, being a part of the beta, or writing a 'PLAY PEACHLEAF PIRATES' message in a bottle and throwing it in the ocean. We hope you enjoy playing! (if you do, please consider leaving a review - every review really helps!)

Matt | Digerati

notes.title: Peachleaf Pirates Dev Stream
notes.notes:
Ahoy me Hearties! Get ready for some adventuring and farming fun in the sun – a Peachleaf Pirates demo is coming later this week! The demo is launching as part of the Steam Game Festival and will be available to download from the game's Steam page for the duration of the event as follows:

Starts: Wednesday, February 3rd, 2021 @ 10AM PST
Ends: Tuesday, February 9th, 2021 @ 10AM PST

The demo consists of your first three days on Peachleaf Island and offers an introductory flavour of what to expect when the full game launches later this year. You'll be able to explore the tropical paradise and meet many of its 'unusual' residents, try your hand at early stage farming and questing, and see how far you can make it through a mysterious and monster-filled jungle temple.

notes.title: Beta starts soon! Sign-up now to experience island life
notes.notes:
Hi there! 

I'm Carl, and I'm the developer of Peachleaf Pirates. I wanted to give you a friendly reminder to [b]sign-up for the Peachleaf Pirates open beta![/b], which you can do right now at this link: [b][url=https://www.digerati.games/peachleafbeta]https://www.digerati.games/peachleafbeta[/url][/b]

The beta kicks off next week, November 4th, and runs until November 18th. 

For everyone who has already signed-up to try my game, thank you so much! It really means the world to me. Peachleaf is my first game, and it's totally surreal for me that it's now at a stage where real actual people (like you) will be playing it!

When I first began work on Peachleaf, I was working in a hotel. I couldn’t code, and I couldn’t draw, but I knew that I wanted to create a game. So I spent all my spare time trying to learn how to program, and every spare second at work writing, sketching, and drawing concepts for the game on everything from napkins to post-it notes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38929209/c776004e7597dd203e50a17d414f809fce385999.png[/img]
 
A lot has happened in my life and the world at large since then. From the very start, my idea was to create a game that you could sink a few hours into after a rough day at work, and hopefully have some fun at the same time. 

Growing up, I loved playing point-n-click adventure games, and I was absolutely enthralled by the Monkey Island-series. I also sank many hours into the original Sims, and pretty much any game since then with base-building or farming. I’ve also always loved a good skill/tech-tree. So, naturally, I wanted to cram all that into my own game. I figured that, if nothing else, I could at least make a game that I would find fun to play.

For the first year or so of development on Peachleaf, whenever I enthusiastically shared my vision of a whimsical point-n-click/farm-sim/rpg mashup, I was met with an echo of people saying it was way too ambitious for my first game, and I should create a Pong-clone instead of this ridiculous project.

I didn’t listen. 

And here we are. 3,941 hours in GameMaker Studio and 3,828 hours in Aseprite later. 

The game is very close to being done, but it's still not completely polished. The full release will have some additional dialogue options throughout the game, and there will be a bit less silence and more music.

Once again, thank you so so much for playing! I can't wait to hear, and learn from, your feedback, and I sincerely hope that you enjoy trying out the game! 

Don't forget to sign-up!: [b][url=https://www.digerati.games/peachleafbeta]https://www.digerati.games/peachleafbeta[/url][/b]
 
Much love, 
Carl | Dog Kiss Studio

notes.title: Peachleaf Pirates – a new tropical RPG! Sign-up now for the beta!
notes.notes:
We’re happy to welcome you to the Steam page for [b]Peachleaf Pirates[/b] – a story-driven RPG inspired by point-and-click classics that offers a relaxing blend of adventuring and casual farm-sim gameplay.

The debut game from one-man developer Dog Kiss Studio, aka Carl-Frederik Wibroe, Peachleaf Pirates is a cheery adventure and timeless tale of finding yourself washed ashore on a strange island with no idea of how you got there. Can you uncover the secrets of Peachleaf? Are you daring enough to fight your way through a monster-filled jungle temple? Or perhaps you'd prefer to while away the days enjoying the cathartic pleasures of tropical farming?

Full feature details can be found [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1156510/Peachleaf_Pirates/]on the Store page[/url][/b], but give the trailer below a watch for a taste of Peachleaf Pirates’ sun-kissed island life: 

[previewyoutube=6D1EtyR069k;full][/previewyoutube]

Peachleaf Pirates will launch on Steam in 2021, but you can [b]sign-up right now for the open beta[/b], which is scheduled to run 4-18 November, at the following link: [b][url=https://www.digerati.games/peachleafbeta]https://www.digerati.games/peachleafbeta[/url][/b]

In addition to signing-up for the beta, don’t forget to [b]add Peachleaf Pirates to your wishlist[/b] and give the game a ‘Follow’ to make sure you stay updated and don't miss a thing! And if you’re a Twitter-bug, you can enjoy a steady stream of Peachleaf wholesomeness here: [b][url=https://twitter.com/PeachleafP]https://twitter.com/PeachleafP[/url][/b]

Matt | Digerati
